$comment: What flowschema holds itself to. `cargo run --release --bin check` reads results/*.json and fails on any rule a run breaks. Change a number only together with its reason in the pull request.

rules.about: A check allocates nothing, valid data or not; a `uniqueItems` keeps one set of the items' hashes.
No typical check, compile or message is slower than jsonschema's.
Every test of the official JSON-Schema-Test-Suite it checks passes, on every draft.
At least 99.95% of MaskBench's answers are judged as labelled.
No schema of MaskBench makes it panic.
On MaskBench it compiles at least 1.5x and checks at least 1.2x faster than jsonschema.
It adds at most 300 KB to a release binary built for size; jsonschema is the comparison.
